name: Owner
meaning: Every permission and capability (ADR-0017 rule 6 interim); approves everywhere.

name: Chief accountant
meaning: Finance and Banking full; supplier documents and sales corrections full; files statutory reports and tax returns; policy administration; payments approved, not posted; partner bank accounts read; other areas read; approves.

name: Accountant
meaning: Finance and Banking post; invoices post; payments drafted and approved, not posted; partners read; posting periods and the chart read; approves.

name: Cashier
meaning: Cash receipts, payments and counts post; bank payments post; other bank documents read; no reports (book queries cannot be narrowed to the cash book).

name: Sales clerk
meaning: Quotations, sales orders and sales corrections edit; customers and price lists edit.

name: Sales manager
meaning: Sales post and approve; price lists read; change proposals edit and approve.

name: Buyer
meaning: Purchase requests, orders and supplier invoices edit; suppliers and planned orders edit.

name: Purchasing manager
meaning: Purchasing post and approve, supplier invoices edit and approve; change proposals edit and approve; planning post.

name: Warehouse keeper
meaning: Inventory post; production issues and receipts post; orders read.

name: Production planner
meaning: Production post; planning full; production structures edit; change proposals edit and approve.

name: Shop floor lead
meaning: Confirmations, production issues and receipts post; production orders read (ADR-0034 rule 18).

name: Auditor
meaning: Read everywhere including audit records; nothing else.

name: IT administrator
meaning: Users, roles, assignments, delegations, organization and settings full; policy and segregation read; no Finance or Banking, no data import, no agent run bodies.

name: Quality inspector
meaning: Inspection lots, results and usage decisions post; approves; inspection plans edit; nonconformances edit; inventory, products and production orders read; delegation of its own approvals edit (ADR-0070; ADR-0054 rule 21).
